text: This report provides the Audit Results, as prepared by PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC), to assist the Board in reviewing the financial statements for the year ended 2019-12-31. The Audit Results Report was reviewed and discussed at the Policy & Finance Committee meeting on 2020-07-08, and was received for information.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Received the report prepared by PricewaterhouseCoopers, attached as Attachment 1 to the report (July 10, 2020) from the Director, Finance and Technology, Toronto Zoo.
